heading: Challenges in extracting key meeting information from meetings and trusting AI-generated summaries.

blocks.html: Since the pandemic, virtual and hybrid meetings have surged in popularity, leading to a rise in AI-powered smart meeting assistant products after 2020. However, many users still struggle with extracting and organizing key meeting information, such as action items. Others also complain that AI meeting summaries are inaccurate and sometimes do not trust AI-generated content.
